verified_facts.text: Hermitage Bay sits on Antigua's west coast, and its namesake bay is shared with no one else.
verified_facts.excerpt: west coast, its namesake bay shared with no one else. Facing the Caribbean Sea

verified_facts.text: The villas are scattered between the hillside and the shore, and every one has a private pool or hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: villas are scattered between the hillside and the shore. Some are steps from the water, others tucked into the trees, and all have a private pool or hot tub.

verified_facts.text: Each villa has air conditioning, an outdoor shower and a generous stand-alone tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each villa comes with air conditioning, an outdoor shower, and a generous stand-alone tub.

verified_facts.text: Villa decks are furnished with sun loungers, day beds and swings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wooden decks are furnished with sun loungers, day beds, swings, and either private pools or hot tubs

verified_facts.text: The Hillside Ocean Pool Villas sit high on the hillside with views over Hermitage Bay and an unobstructed sunset each night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched high on our hillside, these secluded villas offer the ultimate views over Hermitage Bay. For guests who want to truly bask in the beauty of the destination with expansive outdoor living areas, these offer an unobstructed sunset each night.

verified_facts.text: The Beachfront Villas open onto private decks with outdoor swings and day beds, steps from the water.
verified_facts.excerpt: These generous villas open onto private decks with outdoor swings and day beds, just steps from our warm, turquoise waters.

verified_facts.text: The Sanctuary is a private three-bedroom villa with a sun terrace, sauna, cold plunge and jacuzzi pavilion.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private three-bedroom Caribbean villa with calming living spaces, set in the heart of Hermitage Bay. A sun terrace, sauna, cold plunge, and jacuzzi pavilion

verified_facts.text: The open-air spa is wrapped in lush gardens, with the sea before it.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our open-air spa is wrapped in lush gardens, with the sea before you.

verified_facts.text: Every spa treatment is performed with ESPA.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every treatment is performed with ESPA, pairing natural ingredients with modern therapeutic techniques.

verified_facts.text: Yoga, meditation and Pilates take place daily above the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yoga, meditation, and Pilates take place daily above the sea, with the ocean breeze as part of the practice.

verified_facts.text: There is a Technogym fitness center, with personal training available on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Technogym fitness center, with personal training available on request.

verified_facts.text: Guests can choose an all-inclusive plan or bed and breakfast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose the all-inclusive plan, or keep things simple with bed and breakfast

verified_facts.text: The circular Tree Bar is tucked beneath the branches at the edge of the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tucked beneath the branches at the edge of the beach, the circular Tree Bar is where the day slows down and the evening begins.

verified_facts.text: The resort grows many of its own seasonal fruits, vegetables and herbs in an on-site organic garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: we grow many of our own seasonal fruits, vegetables, and herbs right here on the resort in our organic garden

verified_facts.text: La Petite Maison, from the French Riviera, has an exclusive Caribbean residency at Hermitage Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Straight from the French Riviera, this celebrated restaurant brings its sun-kissed Mediterranean menu to Hermitage Bay for an exclusive Caribbean residency.

verified_facts.text: The resort's philosophy is summed up by the word Ubuntu, sometimes described as humanity to others.
verified_facts.excerpt: it is ‘Ubuntu’.  A philosophy sometimes described as ‘humanity to others’ or ‘I am because you are’.

verified_facts.text: Many of the staff have been at the resort for more than a decade.
verified_facts.excerpt: In our home-grown family of staff, many of whom have been here more than a decade, kindness is paramount.

verified_facts.text: Hermitage Bay opened to visitors around the winter holidays in 2006.
verified_facts.excerpt: around the winter holidays in 2006, Hermitage Bay finally opened up to visitors

verified_facts.text: The hillside land was cleared over more than a year to preserve the hillside's natural beauty.
verified_facts.excerpt: It took well over a year to delicately clear the land needed while still preserving the hillside's natural beauty

verified_facts.text: Rattan accents, white linens and mosquito-netted beds give the rooms a Balinese-esque look, with hideaway TVs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rattan accents, white linens, and mosquito-netted beds create a Balinese-esque look, while hideaway TVs encourage you to unplug a little

verified_facts.text: Staff ferry guests on the hill up and down in golf carts.
verified_facts.excerpt: For those up on the hill, staff is on standby to ferry guests up and down in golf carts.

verified_facts.text: Two speed boats and a 103-foot sailboat are on property for boating trips, deep sea fishing and sunset cruises.
verified_facts.excerpt: two speed boats (29- and 44-feet, respectively) and a 103-foot sailboat are now on property and available for guests to enjoy boating trips around the island or head out on deep sea fishing trips and sunset cruises

verified_facts.text: Snorkeling, paddleboarding and kayaking gear are available.
verified_facts.excerpt: Snorkeling, paddleboarding, and kayaking gear are available, too.

verified_facts.text: On the western side of the island, there is nothing within walking distance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated on the western side of the island, there's nothing within walking distance.

verified_facts.text: The hotel can arrange a driver to island sites such as Nelson's Dockyard.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel will be happy to arrange a driver to take you to sites on the island like Nelson's Dockyard and Dow’s Hill Interpretation Center

verified_facts.text: Because the property is very much on the beach, some spaces may be hard to navigate for guests with mobility issues.
verified_facts.excerpt: This property is very much on the beach, so it may be tough for those with mobility issues to navigate certain spaces

verified_facts.text: Large electronics are largely discouraged around the property.
verified_facts.excerpt: large electronics are largely discouraged around the property

verified_facts.text: Guided tours of the organic garden with the gardeners are offered.
verified_facts.excerpt: we are pleased to offer guided tours of the garden with our gardeners

Conde Nast Traveler recognizes Hermitage Bay with its Triple Crown across the Hot List, Gold List and Readers' Choice Awards.
